paragraphs: Hyman cites [Ketubot 100b (Hyman cites 100a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.100b.17) for the account of Rav Kahana holding beer belonging to Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai, an orphan, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Ketubot has Rav Kahana holding the orphan’s beer. The orphan is Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 913) has Ketubot 100a and שכרא, “beer,” where the supplied text reads שברא. The consulted edition places the episode at Ketubot 100b and reads שיכרא. Rav Mesharshiya is the orphan who owns the beer; Rav Kahana is the one holding it. The earlier translation supplied “beer” in brackets.
